Yao Yu made some observations in her (excellent) talk about caching at Twitter over the years ( [link] ) that stuck with me: having a bunch of services doesn't itself isolate problems within one service. Twitter's cache service had to deal with clients rampaging to all load the same key zillions of times, for example.
